summary: Revision 4a fold-equity bug fix validated end-to-end. `cd /app/frontend && npm test` exits 0 with ACCEPTANCE TESTS: 29 passed, GAME TESTS: 12 passed, ENGINE TESTS: 20 passed. The PRIMA/DOPO fold-equity table shows DOPO ordering nit=16.08 > tag=3.40 > whale=-18.87 (tag != 0.00). `node scripts/check-lesson-budget.js` prints OK. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` reports exactly the 7 pre-existing errors (5 in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx OpaqueColorValue, 1 in src/theme.ts 'unspecified', 1 in src/ui/components.tsx:50) with zero errors in src/engine or features/sim. UI regression (rated mode, 390x844) confirms verdict-sheet EV bar chart shows DISTINCT values for each Raise size, Call, All-in, Fold (e.g. Raise 33%=2.4, 50%=2.2, 75%=2.1, 100%=1.9, Call=1.1, Fold=0.0, All-in=-10.3; second hand: 18.5/18.2/17.5/16.7/13.3/10.1/0.0). No NaN, no freeze after node open (background precomputeEv), 0 console errors during rated mode play, 1 pre-existing deprecation warning (props.pointerEvents). Training mode shows 'Equity: 67%' hint on the table and actions work.

critical_code_review_comments: SimController.precomputeEv correctly kicks off in background and the UI remains responsive when a hero node opens.
Fold equity in ev.ts now correctly integrates over the bayesian-tracked villain range using referencePolicy.foldProbForCombo (size-aware) — Raise EV values are distinct per size in the verdict sheet.
Bot calibration multipliers keep observed VPIP/PFR within ~2 pts of target for all 6 profiles over 5000 hands.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Revision 4a is fully green. Engine test suite: 29+12+20 = 61 tests pass. Rated verdict-sheet EV bars have distinct per-size values. Training mode equity hint 'Equity: 67%' renders. Only pre-existing deprecation warning and 7 tsc errors (outside engine/sim).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validated a completed bug fix (fold equity tautology in ev.ts). Old code averaged foldToCbet per profile producing EV=0 for the tag pure-bluff case; new code integrates foldProbForCombo across the tracked range, producing meaningful, distinct EVs for each bet size and villain type.
